contents.title: Relativistic Magnetohydrodynamics, the Blandford–Znajek Mechanism and an Introduction to Numerical Relativity
contents.maindescription: Study of the formalism of general relativistic magnetohydrodynamics (GRMHD), the physics of Shakura–Sunyaev and Novikov–Thorne accretion disks, the Blandford–Znajek and Blandford–Payne mechanisms, and an introduction to numerical relativity with GRMHD torus setups in the iharm3d and Athena++ codes.

contents.title: Introduction to Fiber Bundles: Geometry and Physics

contents.title: Cosmological Tests: How to Know the Evolution of the Universe
contents.institution: IAstro Summer Internships Program, Institute of Astrophysics and Space Sciences
contents.maindescription: Short-term project on the standard cosmological model (ΛCDM) and on fitting supernova data with the emcee package.

contents.title: Introduction to Black Hole Physics and to some Exotic Solutions of General Relativity
contents.maindescription: Three goals: (1) the standard black hole solutions of general relativity, geodesic motion around them and black hole shadows; (2) Morris–Thorne wormholes, warp drive spacetimes and their energy conditions; (3) introductory black hole astrophysics and data analysis of the light curves of 3C 273, M87*, OJ 287 and Sgr A*.

contents.title: Observation and Data Collection of Gravitational Lenses using the Itapetinga Radio Telescope
contents.maindescription: Gravitational lensing with observational data from the Itapetinga Radio Observatory (Pierre Kaufmann Radio Observatory, ROPK), and an analysis of the source PKS 1830.
